PayPal, through its Venmo subsidiary, provides digital payments and commerce services that connect consumers and businesses. The Software Engineer - Android will build and maintain high-quality Android commerce experiences for Venmo, owning features end to end while integrating with backend, payments, identity, risk, search, recommendations, and analytics capabilities.
Finance
FinTech
Apps
Payments
Mobile
No H1B
Responsibilities
Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
May contribute to code & design reviews
Design, build, test, and ship high-quality Android experiences for Venmo Commerce
Develop modern, reusable UI using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose within Venmo's mobile architecture
Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation through experimentation, launch, observability, and iteration
Integrate mobile experiences with backend APIs, payments infrastructure, identity, risk, search, recommendations, analytics, and other platform capabilities
Build experiences that are performant, resilient, accessible, secure, and intuitive across a broad range of Android devices
Instrument product funnels and experiments, use data to understand customer behavior, and partner with Product and Data Science to improve outcomes
Collaborate closely with iOS engineers to deliver coherent cross-platform experiences while applying Android-native patterns and best practices
Participate in architecture and technical design reviews, contribute to code reviews, and raise the engineering quality bar across the team
Debug and resolve production issues and contribute to the operational health of commerce experiences
Qualification

Feature Ownership
Required
1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience building production Android apps in Kotlin
Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, and Flow used in production, not just in a side project
Solid architecture fundamentals: MVVM or MVI, multi module Gradle, dependency injection with Hilt
REST or GraphQL integration with Retrofit and OkHttp, plus sensible caching and offline handling
Testing as a habit: JUnit, MockK, Compose UI tests
Clear written communication and a bias toward owning a feature end to end
Visa Sponsorship through PayPal is not available for this position now or any time in the future
Preferred
Payments or fintech background, PCI DSS awareness, Android Keystore and biometric auth, feature flags and experimentation, accessibility, marketplace or ecommerce product work
Benefits
Additional compensation may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable.
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office and 2 days at either the PayPal office or home workspace.
Comprehensive, choice-based programs supporting physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing.
